messages:
maria (marketing): Hey team — launching a co-marketing push with Lighthouse Cloud next month. Want to lock webinar + benchmark blog + marketplace listing. High-level asks: 1) joint webinar (45m + 15m Q&A) 2) benchmark blog comparing Redwood Dedicated vs Lighthouse-managed endpoints 3) marketplace listing copy and assets 4) inbound lead routing + demo offers. Thoughts/owners?

ashok (growth): +1. Proposed webinar date Tue Apr 28, 10am PT. Works for Lighthouse? Need a short reg form, partner co-host on slides, and a promo timeline.

laura (partner): Lighthouse confirmed Apr 28 10am PT. They prefer a 30-40m demo + AMA. They can surface a customer for a 3-min case quote. I'll own partner approvals and legal sync.

sam (content): I'll draft the blog outline and the benchmark narrative. To do that I need a test workload and perf numbers from eng: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s), and cost per 1M tokens across baseline vs quantized. Also any gotchas about reproducibility.

ashok (growth): For inbound routing — route Lighthouse leads to their partner-sales queue, Redwood MQLs to SDR. Use UTMs: ?utm_source=lighthouse&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=lighthouse_launch. Add hidden fields on reg form.

maria (marketing): Quick reg form snippet we can use:
```
name, email, company, role, use_case, demo_interest (yes/no), opt_in_newsletter, utm_source, utm_campaign
```
Set demo_interest -> triggers demo routing. Keep form 6 fields max.

dev-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1789032100 (organizer: marketing).

sam (content): For the benchmark blog, can eng-ml provide a 10k-token mixed workload (summarize + codegen + retrieval) run? Need p50/p95, average tokens/sec, cost delta for fp16 vs int8/4-bit. Also config like model version, sequence length, batch sizes.

nik (eng-ml): Yep — I can run a 10k mixed workload and upload results. Will include p50/p95, throughput, and a short table of quantization effects by EOD Wed. I'll note exact model commit and seq len distribution.

laura (partner): Logo and brand assets uploaded here: https://assets.lighthouse.com/redwood-partner.zip. Legal flagged co-marketing agreement; we need signatures before publish. I'll get that started.

maria (marketing): Visuals plan: co-branded slide deck, 1 tweet thread + 2 social posts, blog + webinar page. Proposed cadence: Week 0 announcement (social), Week 1 publish benchmark blog, Week 2 webinar, Week 3 follow-up case study + recording.

ashok (growth): Tracking checklist: create Zapier webhook to push registrants to CRM with tag "lighthouse_partner". Also add contact property "source: lighthouse_webinar". I can set this up once form is live.

sam (content): Draft blog headline ideas: "Latency vs Cost: How Redwood Dedicated + Lighthouse Cuts Inference TCO" or "Partnering for Predictable LLM Inference: Redwood + Lighthouse Benchmark". I'll open a PR for copy tomorrow. Need a 1-2 sentence quote from Lighthouse (Laura) and a short technical blurb from Nik.

maria (marketing): Marketplace listing: will need 300-500 char description, 600x200 hero image, and 3 bullet highlights (integration, SSO, dedicated capacity). Can someone own copy?

laura (partner): I can draft listing copy and confirm marketplace requirements. Also need to check the partner portal for asset guidelines.

maria (marketing): Who will run the live demo? Suggest Lighthouse does infra/customer-facing demo; Redwood demos ops/latency/cost dashboards and live inference. @tom (solutions) volunteer?

tom (solutions): I can run the Redwood demo. Will prepare slides + a short terminal demo against a test tenant. Need an API key and test tenant with sample data.

dev-bot: API key request ticket created #INC-8421.

nik (eng-ml): I'll produce the perf artifact (notebooks + raw logs) and put them in the shared folder. Please don't publish raw logs publicly; I'll prepare a sanitized CSV for the blog.

ashok (growth): Rehearsal: Wed Apr 24 9am PT — block 60m. I'll send calendar invites to hosts, partner PM, and demos.

maria (marketing): Promo copy plan: 3 weeks of assets. Week -2: teaser (social), Week -1: blog + gated benchmark, Week 0: webinar push + reminder. Post-webinar: recording + follow-up CTAs (book a demo).

sam (content): For gated download, should we require job title + company? Might reduce conversion but increase lead quality. Recommend require role + opt-in.

ashok (growth): Agree to require role. We'll mark registrants with "demo_interest" yes to trigger SDR follow-up within 48 hours.

laura (partner): Lighthouse legal expects co-marketing agreement signed before assets go live; ETA 3 business days once I circulate.

maria (marketing): Okay owners recap: webinar logistics (ashok), partner coordination & legal (laura), content/blog (sam), eng metrics and artifacts (nik), demo (tom), promo + landing & CTAs (maria). I'll assemble a single checklist doc and share.

sam (content): Will PR draft by Tue morning and ping for quotes.

laura (partner): Confirmed — will get legal moving and share partner quote draft.

maria (marketing): Great — thanks everyone :rocket: If anything blocks, drop here or DM.
